boundary.en: 肚 dù is a body-part candidate carried through the abdomen family, not the standard adjective translation. Abdominal means relating to the abdomen: 腹部的. Shared family evidence is counted once; historical relation with Chinese is not claimed.

meaning.en: Abdominal is an adjective modifying a noun, as in abdominal muscles. Abdomen is the separate body-part noun. 肚 is only a family-based candidate, not an adjective equivalent.

summary.en: English abdominal uses the Latin stem abdōmin- of abdōmen with -al. French abdominal is derived from abdomen with -al; abdominale is the feminine form. The deeper origin of abdomen remains uncertain. This does not establish a relationship to Chinese 肚.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 abdominal 由拉丁语 abdōmen 的词干 abdōmin- 加 -al 构成。法语 abdominal 由 abdomen 加 -al 派生，abdominale 为阴性形式。abdomen 的更深来源仍不确定；上述词史不能证明与汉语“肚”有关。

summary.en: Abdominal has four syllables and stress on /dɒm/ (UK) or /dɑː/ (US). 肚 dù is one syllable [tu˥˩]. English /d/ and Mandarin [t] share a coronal stop articulation but differ in voicing; /ɒ/ or /ɑː/ is not /u/, and /b m n l/, extra syllables and Mandarin tone have no full counterparts. Similarity is partial, not homophony.
summary.zh-Hans: abdominal 为四音节，重音在 /dɒm/（英）或 /dɑː/（美）；肚 dù 为单音节 [tu˥˩]。英语 /d/ 与普通话 [t] 同为冠音塞音，但清浊不同；/ɒ/ 或 /ɑː/ 不等于 /u/；/b m n l/、额外音节与普通话声调均无完整对应。只属局部相似，不是同音。

source.raw_note: 英语：abdomen ['æbdəmən] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；ab.dom.en；abdominal [æb'dɔminəl] a. 腹；ab.dom.inal；domain n. 领地；dome n. 圆顶，肚子就是圆形的；domestic a. 领域内的；dominant a. 主导的；dominate v. 支配。法语：ab.dom.en [abdomen] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；ab.domin.al,e [abdominal] n. 腹 [<拉丁语]；abdominal (masculine)，abdominale (feminine)。汉语：肚【du】n. 肚子。备注：以上这些词汇大概都是由 dome 圆顶的根词演化而来的。也可以与肚 du 子的意思对应得上。主导等等词汇我们一般用手的词汇构成，例如手下，翻手为云覆手为雨。也许英语法语词汇用与肚子有关的词汇表达统治主导的意思。中文原文：肚子是我们的领地吗？当我们都是孩提时代，那在腹部上面的肚兜是啥模样？似乎都忘记想了。孩提时代的脸庞是水灵灵的。那女孩子们，大自然在给你们柔媚如月般的皎洁的时候。不忘记让你随着那月行走。那男孩子们，大自然在给你们阳光的面庞的时候，也没有忘记给你们随那太阳起落。用户英文原稿：Is the belly our domain? When we were children, what did the bellyband look like? I seem to have forgotten it. The face of a child is watery. Girls, when nature gave you the softness of the moon, it did not forget to let you walk with the moon. Boys, when nature gave you the sunny face, it also did not forget to let you rise and fall with the sun.
